name: Abd al-Rahman al-Jabarti
contribution: An Egyptian Islamic scholar and historian who spent most of his life in Cairo.

checks.lead: Abd al-Rahman ibn Hasan al-Jabarti (Arabic: عبد الرحمن بن حسن الجبرتي, romanized: ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān ibn Ḥasan al-Jabartī; 1753–1825) was an Egyptian Islamic scholar and historian who spent most of his life in Cairo.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
